title: Chapter 1424
text:
The intense battle between the World Tree Army and the Galactic Alliance Army at the border lasted for two months, but the World Tree was still unable to completely enter the Flickering World territory. Although it had broken through the Galactic Alliance Army's defense line several times and allowed the fleet to drill in, the defense circle that the three Universal Civilizations had built over the past decade was far more perfect than the temporary interception circle back then. The support network was extremely dense, like an extremely dense elastic net.

The deeper they fell, the greater the rebound. They could not gain a foothold at all. All the World Tree troops that attacked the Flickering World were either expelled or annihilated. The best record only lasted for less than three days, and they did not even pass through the border Star System.

The border battle reports of the Flickering World were constantly sent back to the Central Galaxy and spread throughout the galactic society. Countless galactic residents had been in fear for more than ten years. Now that the enemy had truly invaded their country, many people were even more afraid. However, because the Galactic Alliance Army had always blocked the enemy outside their territory, their outstanding performance gave most of the galactic residents more confidence.

In the Sibbert Fortress, many Beyond Grade As had been on standby for two months.

"Heh, didn't the World Tree like to use its individual strength to exchange with us in the past? Why is it so cowardly now? It's getting worse and worse."

In the lounge, Sun Hunter stepped on the table, his tone full of disdain.

"They're probably afraid of Black Star. He caught a Tree King more than ten years ago, so it must have hurt them," Kant said with a smile.

In the past two months, no matter how they provoked or tempted them, the World Tree never allowed them to send out their individual strength. They calmly watched the Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations cause trouble on the battlefield.

The Beyond Grade As rubbed their palms together helplessly. No matter how strong their fighting spirit was, there was nothing they could do if they did not take the bait. They had even used their bodies to tempt them, but the World Tree experts still did not come out. They were like cowards.

"You're thinking too much. The World Tree isn't that afraid of me. They should be observing the number of our individual strength. They won't give up on the exchange tactic so easily. They'll probably take action soon."

Han Xiao played with Ames's hair and replied casually.

He had been accompanying everyone here on standby, waiting for the big fish to be caught.

In the past few days, the three Universal Civilizations had concealed the true scale of their individual strength. Most of the dozens of new Beyond Grade As did not go on stage, and Hella, Fu Ding, Evans, and the other experts with special abilities or huge improvements did not take action either. At the same time, the Beyond Grade As who had 'sacrificed' in the last battle of the intercepting circle did not appear either, allowing them to continue to maintain their 'dead' status in the eyes of the World Tree.

In the Holy Covenant organization that others did not know about, there were still dozens of revivors who were ready to participate in the battle at any time. The individual strength displayed in front of the World Tree was only the tip of the iceberg. The purpose was to make the World Tree think that the exchange tactic was effective and fall into the trap.

After more than ten years of searching, Oathkeeper had accumulated several Sanctum keys. Han Xiao had not used them all this time, treating them as strategic reserves. These were all capital to be used.

"Buzz, buzz, buzz …"

Just as everyone was chatting, the alarm suddenly rang, and the World Tree launched another attack on the outermost defense circle.

Everyone paused. Before they could move, the remote projection of an officer suddenly appeared in the room and said with a deep voice,

"Everyone, the Beyond Grade As of the World Tree have finally appeared. Please arrive at the battlefield as soon as possible."

Hearing this, Han Xiao's eyes flashed.

"They're finally here … Is there a Tree King this time?"

"Yes!"

"Which one is here?"

"Two, the Lord's Avatars of the Subduing Tree King and the Fortitude Tree King."

Kasuyi could not help but smile and interrupt. "With the lesson from last time, the World Tree doesn't dare to let the Tree King come out alone. However, the configuration this time is similar to last time. I'm afraid they feel that as long as they are more careful, they won't fall for it like the Heart Tree King."

This time, a new Beyond Grade A asked curiously, "The Tree King has appeared.

How is it? Is Your Excellency Black Star going to fight? "

"Just one Subduing Tree King … Forget it, I'll leave him to you guys."

Han Xiao stroked his chin, thought for a while, and clicked his tongue.

He hoped to catch a big fish. At the very least, it would be a Fortitude Tree King, preferably an Ancestral Tree King. It was not worth it to expose his strength for a mere Subduing Tree King … He just despised the Subduing Tree King for being a Pugilist. His function was too simple, and his importance was far inferior to the other Tree Kings.

Furthermore, there were many experts in the Beyond Grade A Association now. He did not need to do anything to kill the Subduing Tree King. As long as he killed this tool and made him unable to revive in the short term, he should be able to lure out the Ancestral Tree King and the Secret Tree King. That was the better prey in Han Xiao's eyes.

Hella's eyes lit up as if she was afraid that someone would snatch her opponent away. She immediately said, "Then leave this guy to me!"

Han Xiao raised his brows and poured cold water on her mercilessly. "Although your improvement is not small, you're still far from killing a Tree King."

"We'll know after we try." Hella's eyes flashed coldly.

"Alright, as long as you don't let him escape." Han Xiao curled his lips.

Originally, Wuornos was the most stable person to deal with the Tree King, but this b * stard had not left the Temple of Ten Thousand Gods for more than ten years and still had no intention of participating in the battle. However, with the Underworld's big brother, there was no lack of strong men.

At this moment, Han Xiao noticed that Evans's palm was trembling slightly. He could not help but feel strange. "Are you afraid?"

"This is my first time on the battlefield, and it's a galactic war of this scale. I'm indeed a little afraid." Evans was calm.

Lagi, who was at the side, muttered softly, "What's the use of being afraid? Don't tell me I won't die in battle if I'm afraid … I didn't expect to die after becoming a Beyond Grade A for only a few years. Sigh, as expected, someone like me doesn't have the right to enjoy life …"

"You better shut up."

Han Xiao said in annoyance, interrupting this chatting genius.

If not for the fact that you're more or less a combatant, I would have locked you in amber today!

…

At this moment, at the border.

The enormous World Tree fleet was attacking the defensive circle, and the fleets of the Galactic Alliance Army cooperated with the various strongholds to counterattack. Countless rays of terrifying power shuttled back and forth in the vast universe battlefield, forming a resplendent but fatal rain of light that shot into each other's formations, causing spaceships to explode into fireworks in space.

This was not the first time the two sides had fought, and the battle quickly reached its climax. The troops moved under the command of the various military artificial intelligences. From a macroscopic perspective, it looked like a large-scale exchange of fire, but in fact, both sides were adjusting their tactics every moment.

On the battlefield, a group of World Tree Beyond Grade As, who were emitting astonishing energy, were observing the battlefield from afar under the protection of their own starships.

The Subduing Tree King had his hands behind his back as he scanned the formation of the Galactic Alliance Army with his sharp eyes.

Not long after, the Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations also arrived at the battlefield one after another. The two sides faced each other from afar. Because only a portion of them appeared, they did not seem to have as many people as the World Tree experts.

The group that appeared was mainly the Beyond Grade As who had participated in the interception circle battle. The others were hiding in the dark.

Seeing this, the Subduing Tree King narrowed his eyes and nodded.

"Humph, many of them died last time. They are no match for us this time."

In the past two months, he had been observing the situation of the Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations. Most of them were old opponents. Although there were some new faces, the number was limited. They were probably new Beyond Grade As.

He was not surprised by this. The World Tree had also been nurturing Supers for the past ten years, and it had also given birth to some new Holy Tree Emissaries and Ancestral Spirits. The scale of their individual strength had also increased.

A portion of the enemy's individual strength had died in the battle more than ten years ago, and the dead of the World Tree had all been revived. The Subduing Tree King was quite confident.

However, the Heart Tree King had already fallen. As a Pugilist, it was very difficult for him to instantly kill the enemy's healer. The last time he tried, he fell into Black Star's trap and was unfortunately killed. Therefore, the Subduing Tree King did not intend to repeat the same mistake. This time, he had only gathered the World Tree experts to test the waters.

Scanning the enemy, the Subduing Tree King's eyes suddenly focused. He realized that there was no trace of Black Star.

"That guy didn't come out? No, he must be hiding and planning a sneak attack. "

The Subduing Tree King became vigilant.

The only thing he was worried about was Black Star. The Heart Tree King had been sealed, and he did not want to follow in his footsteps. He was secretly on guard, afraid that Han Xiao would jump out and stab him.

As the saying went, when enemies met, their eyes would turn red. The Beyond Grade As on both sides charged toward each other without saying a word and immediately started fighting on the battlefield, forming a large chaotic area.

The Subduing Tree King activated his liberation form without hesitation, and his entire body shone with a green light. He had wanted to force Black Star out, but he did not expect to be stopped by a red-haired woman.

"Your opponent is me."

Hella stood in front of the Subduing Tree King with a cold expression and a strong killing intent in her eyes.

The Subduing Tree King's eyes flickered. He had some impression of Hella.

"It's you? Hmm, your self-healing ability is not bad, but you want to stop me with your combat strength? "

Other than Black Star, the Subduing Tree King was not afraid of anyone. Thinking of Hella's performance on the battlefield more than ten years ago, he did not take her seriously.

Hella did not have the habit of shooting her mouth off. Hearing this, she snorted coldly and erupted with a powerful aura. Bright red death energy whistled out.

The Subduing Tree King suddenly felt a threat, and his expression changed. He looked at Hella with surprise.

"She's actually become so strong?"

Without a doubt, this red-haired woman had already entered the peak Beyond Grade A realm, and her energy fluctuations were at the upper tier of peak Beyond Grade As … It had only been ten years since they last met, but she had improved so much?

The Subduing Tree King's expression became solemn. Although there was still a gap between the two of them, he had to admit that this woman in front of him already had the qualifications to fight him.

He sensed the battle situation of his other companions and realized that the improvement of the enemy Beyond Grade As was far higher than that of their World Tree experts. Although they were at a disadvantage in terms of numbers, they were not at a disadvantage.

"How did they train?" The Subduing Tree King was shocked.

In just ten years, they had improved so much. How could it be so easy for a Beyond Grade A to increase their combat strength? Could it be that the enemy's territory was filled with outstanding people, and all of them were geniuses?
